title: ROG: A Multi-Layer Manually Annotated Corpus of Spoken Slovenian
manual_evidence: approximately half includes manually annotated prosodic units, disfluencies, and dialogue acts; annotation layers aligned to recordings
primary_or_secondary: secondary recordings with new annotation layer
public_access: transcriptions/annotations public; approximately half audio CC-BY
reason_for_review: Underlying GOS 2/SST recordings are pre-existing. Admit only if the newly contributed manual prosodic/interaction annotation can be isolated cleanly from inherited material and file-level provenance/license is verified.
notes: Potential inclusion exception: genuinely new manual prosodic annotations over pre-existing recordings; do not admit inherited annotations as new observations.
